extractor: read directly from the official INZ page listed in source_roles
policy: Every entry quotes the official page it was read from. source_excerpt is verbatim government wording, lowercased by the normalizer. Nothing here is paraphrased into a requirement, and nothing is included that the page did not state.
not_extracted: ANZSCO / NOL skill levels and their qualification thresholds. INZ links separate pages; not registered sources, and a recalled threshold would be a fabricated requirement.
The median wage figure the job must be paid at. INZ's sentence links out rather than stating a number on this page.
Employer accreditation and the job check process. These are the EMPLOYER's obligations, on separate pages, and are not applicant requirements.
The list of occupations requiring occupational registration. Linked, not stated.
Partner and dependent children conditions, which INZ handles as separate visa types.

requirements.label: A full-time job offer from an accredited employer
requirements.source_excerpt: have an offer of full-time work from an accredited employer
requirements.source_excerpt_display: have an offer of full-time work from an accredited employer

requirements.label: The offer must be current, at least 30 hours a week, from an accredited employer with an approved job check
requirements.source_excerpt: your job offer must be: current at the time you apply for your visa for at least 30 hours of work a week from an employer who is accredited to hire migrants for the accredited employer work visa (aewv) and has an approved job check for your job
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your job offer must be: current at the time you apply for your visa for at least 30 hours of work a week from an employer who is accredited to hire migrants for the Accredited Employer Work Visa (AEWV) and has an approved job check for your job

requirements.label: Meet INZ's skill requirements for your job
requirements.description: ANZSCO/NOL skill levels are defined on separate INZ pages that are not registered sources, so no threshold is recorded.
requirements.source_excerpt: meet our skill requirements meet the requirements of your job's anzsco or nol skill level and qualifications have the skills and experience your employer requires
requirements.source_excerpt_display: meet our skill requirements meet the requirements of your job's ANZSCO or NOL skill level and qualifications have the skills and experience your employer requires

requirements.label: Time spent outside New Zealand may be required before another AEWV
requirements.description: Applies only to repeat AEWV holders. VisaAI holds no record of prior AEWV stays, so no rule is attached.

requirements.label: An application is declined if money was offered or promised for the job offer
requirements.description: INZ pairs this with a warning that job offer scams are common in India and South Asia. Recorded because the consequence is refusal, not merely advice.
requirements.source_excerpt: we will decline an application for an aewv if we consider you or your agent has offered or promised money to the employer (or their agent) in exchange for a job offer.
